messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Memory surface alert on node gpu-n42 - multiple CUDA OOMs reported despite headroom showing available memory. Auto-scaling attempted but some containers crashed.
Maya (oncall): on it. seeing repeated cudaMalloc failures in logs, but headroom metric still ~1.2GB. linking logs.
Omar (serving-runtime): likely allocator fragmentation / reserved-block mismatch. could be KV cache spikes. will pull allocator report.
Jenn (platform): moving traffic off gpu-n42, cordoning node. please avoid redeploys to that host.
Maya (oncall): cordon done, draining non-critical pods. rolling routing to fallback pool.
Maya (oncall): quick mitigation: set per-request batch_size=1 for affected model route and enable soft-fallback to quantized-variant.
Liam (sre): noticed spike in prefetch/reserve requests right before the OOMs. sending heap snapshot.
Omar (serving-runtime): paste allocator dump:
```
Allocator snapshot node=gpu-n42
Reserved blocks: 128MB segments x3
Free holes: multiple small fragments ~4-16MB
Headroom metric: 1.2GB
Recent allocations: 512MB, 768MB, 1.1GB
Fragmentation ratio: 0.72
```
Maya (oncall): interesting — headroom measures free bytes but doesn't account for contiguous chunk needs. fragmentation explains cudaMalloc failures.
Jenn (platform): rolling a graceful restart for chat-worker{3,4} to free large contiguous region. will also lower KV cache prefetch aggressiveness.
runbook-bot: Runbook step applied: increase sparepool margin -> command `infractl sparepool adjust --add 2 --region us-west1` executed by Jenn.
Omar (serving-runtime): added a mitigation change: disable aggressive prefetch on that node with a hotfix flag.
Maya (oncall): customer impact: streaming requests for a small subset of premium orgs saw 503s or stalls, about 6 orgs, window ~2-8 minutes. alerting CS.
Jenn (platform): CS notified with incident stub. no data leak, just availability for a subset of endpoints.
Maya (oncall): can we get raw crash traces?
Omar (serving-runtime): yes, tail of worker log:
```
E 03:12:52 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (alloc 2323456b)
E 03:12:52 attempting reserve fallback -> failed
E 03:12:53 killing container due to OOM
```
Liam (sre): temporary mitigation timeline: cordon/drain + restart freed contiguous blocks; traffic redirected; errors subsided at +7m.
Maya (oncall): handing off to night oncall @Liam — will post postmortem notes and timeline. leaving this thread open for follow-up.
Liam (sre): ack handoff. i'll collect heap dumps and run fragmentation remediation (defragment allocator + bump sparepool) tomorrow morning.
Maya (oncall): tagging owners: @Omar to investigate allocator heuristics (coalescing, reserve policy), @Jenn to validate sparepool thresholds, @SRE to verify alerting thresholds for fragmentation.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV3. Link to incident doc: https://go.redwood/incident/2812345678
Maya (oncall): quick runbook snippet for next time added to thread: prefer evicting KV cache keys before restarting containers; prefer fallback model variant and reduce batch sizes dynamically.
Liam (sre): final note: no persistent data corruption, node healthy after drain + restarts. will coordinate a scheduled patch rollout to change reserve allocation policy.
Maya (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: closing active mitigation, moving to postmortem tracking.
